changes.title: Adoption roadmap: Getting your sales team to actually use AI notetakers
changes.original: Sales teams resist AI notetakers when tools feel like surveillance or disrupt client rapport with visible bots.
changes.replacement: Sales teams adopt AI notetakers when the tool saves real time and keeps reps focused on the client conversation. This 90-day roadmap shows how to pilot with champions, operationalize through peer-led training, and measure CRM coverage and deal velocity impact.

changes.title: Adoption roadmap: Getting your sales team to actually use AI notetakers
changes.original: TL;DR: Sales teams resist AI notetakers when tools feel like surveillance or disrupt client rapport with visible bots.
changes.replacement: TL;DR: Sales teams adopt AI notetakers when the tool proves individual time savings fast and fits how reps already run calls. Adoption succeeds when you prove time savings in week one (target: 3-4 hours saved per rep) and let senior reps lead the rollout instead of management mandate. This 90-day roadmap shows how to pilot with 2-3 champions (Days 1-30), operationalize through peer-led training (Days 31-60), and measure CRM coverage and deal velocity impact (Days 61-90). Granola generates accurate notes from your rough bullets so reps spend less time writing calls up.

changes.title: Adoption roadmap: Getting your sales team to actually use AI notetakers
changes.original: Granola's device audio capture eliminates bot friction while maintaining transcription accuracy.
changes.replacement: Granola captures device audio and produces accurate transcripts, so reps can stay in the conversation and still get structured notes afterwards.

changes.title: Adoption roadmap: Getting your sales team to actually use AI notetakers
changes.original: Client discomfort with visible bots and reps perceiving the tool as surveillance rather than assistance.
changes.replacement: What are the biggest risks of AI notetakers for sales? Reps perceiving the tool as surveillance rather than assistance, and notes that are too generic to be useful in a deal review. Mitigate by keeping notes private to the rep by default and choosing a tool that builds on the bullets reps already write.

changes.title: Adoption roadmap: Getting your sales team to actually use AI notetakers
changes.original: When a meeting bot announces itself or appears in the Zoom gallery, prospects pause and ask why they are being recorded.

changes.title: Adoption roadmap: Getting your sales team to actually use AI notetakers
changes.original: The reason is architectural: most AI notetakers join meetings as visible bots, forcing reps to choose between accurate documentation and protecting the client relationship they worked months to build.
changes.replacement: The reason is fit: most tools ask reps to change how they run a call, and the documentation they produce does not reflect what the rep actually cared about in the conversation.

changes.title: Adoption roadmap: Getting your sales team to actually use AI notetakers
changes.original: Bot embarrassment kills adoption before it starts.
changes.replacement: Tool fatigue kills adoption before it starts. If a rep has to change how they run a call to accommodate the software, they will drop it after a week or two. Adoption sticks when the tool fits the way reps already work and gives them something useful the moment the call ends.
